text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-The confrontation between the Labour Confederation and the government is taking a political dimension.
-Prime Minister Hariri to meet President Chirac in Paris on his way back from Canada. He said: Some people destroyed Lebanon and it's our duty to rebuild it.
-Parliament Speaker Berri ends his visit to Qatar and welcomes the idea of an Arab common market.
-Israeli troops shelled areas on the edge of the eastern sector of the south Lebanon occupation zone.
-Trade deficit up to $508 million in February from $426 million in January.
-The Lebanese pound regained ground against the U.S. dollar in quiet interbank trade in Beirut.
-Foreign Minister Bouez in Malta: Any peace initiative should be based on U.N. resolutions.
